name: Thomas Beekman
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Kinderhook, Columbia County, N.Y., July 4, 1790; lawyer; town clerk of Smithfield, N.Y., 1824; elected as an Anti-Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-first Congress (March 4, 1829-March 3, 1831); farmer; died on February 2, 1870, in Kinderhook, N.Y.; interment in Kinderhook Cemetery, Kinderhook, N.Y.
